scientific_integrity: An algebraic proof and exact finite-field checks are provided; finite computations are not used as proofs of infinite claims. No author or publication claim is made.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite ranks are finite Gaussian-binomial inversion sums. The limit fixes the prime. No extension-field or quantitative-rate claim. Random matrix eigenspace asymptotics have classical antecedents; priority of the combined additive-convolution spectral law has not been independently established.
title: Fourier spectral law of rank-one idempotent convolution on matrix spaces
